scientific.integrity: The proof uses exact polar section integration, a Santaló centroid characterization, a positive beta-mixture variance identity, and Jensen monotonicity. It is valid for arbitrary convex bases. Full accessible primary texts were compared at matching object/parameter and at the pyramid endpoint. Computational checks are supplementary diagnostics only.
limitations: Only homothetic frusta with a common homothety center are covered; arbitrary skew prismatoids are not.
The base is translated to its own Santaló point; the theorem does not assert the axial formula at an arbitrary original coordinate origin.
The pyramid endpoint is established prior work and is cited rather than claimed as new.
An equivalent unpublished or unindexed elementary frustum formula cannot be excluded.

title: Universal Santaló and volume-product laws for homothetic frusta
